name: langgraph-workflow
description: Durable, verified workflows (verified change, read-only research) that the Locus agent drives step by step, with plan approval asked of you directly.

interface.shortDescription: Durable, verified multi-step workflows with crash recovery and plan approval.
interface.longDescription: Runs LangGraph workflows as an MCP server. The Locus agent performs every job with its own tools and permissions and reports back; the plugin keeps durable state, detects file changes itself, verifies file and JSON acceptance checks, and asks you to approve plans through a Locus prompt. Command checks and human-review checks end in needs-review rather than being assumed to pass.
